name: cg-companion
description: Optional Chitragupta native companion: read-only panes over cached projections; requires the adjacent Chitragupta checkout.

auto_open.title: Open the companion at start
auto_open.description: Open the Chitragupta pane when a session starts (wide terminals only; never other panes). Off by default.

prompt_band.title: Prompt band
prompt_band.description: Show one Chitragupta summary line above the prompt, from the last cached read. Off by default.

privacy.title: Privacy mode
privacy.description: Mask ticket and pull request titles in the companion and the band. Does not redact your transcript.

accent.title: Accent
accent.description: Heading accent, from your Claude Code theme.

mark.title: Header mark
mark.description: Text mark in the companion header only (at most 12 plain characters). It never replaces Claude Code's own logo.
